name: relay
description: Run any Relay model, poll long tasks, upload files, run workflows and search the Relay docs.
long_description: Relay's MCP server. Your agent finds a Relay model, reads its input schema, runs it, polls long tasks, uploads files, runs workflows and searches the Relay docs. The tools take the model as a string, so a model added to Relay works without a new release. Your key stays in Claude Desktop's secure storage and is only sent to Relay.

api_key.title: Relay API key
api_key.description: Your relay_sk_... key from dashboard.relaygpu.com/keys. Search and pricing work without it; running models needs it.
